newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Countrywide bank drops NZ floating rate to 9.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Countrywide bank drops NZ floating rate to 9.4 pct.

text.p: Countrywide Bank said on Wednesday it had dropped its New Zealand floating mortgage rate to 9.4 percent from 9.95 percent, effective immediately for new customers and from May 28 for existing customers.
Countrywide said the new rate was the lowest floating mortgage interest rate it had offered since late 1994.

"The decrease follows a drop in 90-day bill rates following the release of the Consumer Price Index yesterday, which showed the first fall in the index in seven years. Wholesale rates are now in line with the Reserve Bank's March forecast at below 7.5 percent," the bank said.
